cpi.name: Transparency International Corruption Perceptions Index
cpi.licence: CC BY-ND 4.0 (as stated by Transparency International for the CPI data; scores and ranks are stored exactly as published, with no adaptation)
cpi.basis: 13 expert assessments and business surveys of public-sector corruption, 100 = very clean
cpi.note: Measures perceived public-sector corruption; scores carry a published standard error.

rsf.name: Reporters Without Borders World Press Freedom Index
rsf.licence: No licence statement found; RSF publishes the index for free download. Scores and ranks are reused unmodified with attribution; no further reuse rights are claimed.
rsf.basis: Annual survey of journalists and experts plus a count of abuses: political, economic, legal, social and safety indicators
rsf.note: Measures press freedom only, a narrower thing than the WGI voice and accountability score.

vdem_elec.name: V-Dem Electoral Democracy Index
vdem_elec.publisher: V-Dem Institute (University of Gothenburg), republished by Our World in Data
vdem_elec.licence: V-Dem data are CC BY-SA 4.0 (this file is shared under the same licence). Cite: Coppedge et al. 2026, V-Dem Dataset v16, Varieties of Democracy Project, https://doi.org/10.23696/vdemds26. Fetched through Our World in Data's republication (CC BY 4.0).
vdem_elec.basis: Expert-coded: clean elections, suffrage, freedom of association and expression, elected officials
vdem_elec.note: Model-based estimates from several thousand country experts; V-Dem publishes no ranks, so the rank shown is computed here on the latest year.

vdem_lib.name: V-Dem Liberal Democracy Index
vdem_lib.publisher: V-Dem Institute (University of Gothenburg), republished by Our World in Data
vdem_lib.licence: V-Dem data are CC BY-SA 4.0 (this file is shared under the same licence). Cite: Coppedge et al. 2026, V-Dem Dataset v16, Varieties of Democracy Project, https://doi.org/10.23696/vdemds26. Fetched through Our World in Data's republication (CC BY 4.0).
vdem_lib.basis: Electoral democracy plus rule of law, judicial and legislative constraints on the executive
vdem_lib.note: Model-based estimates from several thousand country experts; V-Dem publishes no ranks, so the rank shown is computed here on the latest year.

vdem_civ.name: V-Dem Civil Liberties Index (human rights index)
vdem_civ.publisher: V-Dem Institute (University of Gothenburg), republished by Our World in Data
vdem_civ.licence: V-Dem data are CC BY-SA 4.0 (this file is shared under the same licence). Cite: Coppedge et al. 2026, V-Dem Dataset v16, Varieties of Democracy Project, https://doi.org/10.23696/vdemds26. Fetched through Our World in Data's republication (CC BY 4.0).
vdem_civ.basis: Expert-coded: freedom from torture, political killings and forced labour; freedom of movement, religion, expression and association
vdem_civ.note: Model-based estimates from several thousand country experts; V-Dem publishes no ranks, so the rank shown is computed here on the latest year.

vdem_rule.name: V-Dem Rule of Law Index
vdem_rule.publisher: V-Dem Institute (University of Gothenburg), republished by Our World in Data
vdem_rule.licence: V-Dem data are CC BY-SA 4.0 (this file is shared under the same licence). Cite: Coppedge et al. 2026, V-Dem Dataset v16, Varieties of Democracy Project, https://doi.org/10.23696/vdemds26. Fetched through Our World in Data's republication (CC BY 4.0).
vdem_rule.basis: Expert-coded: compliance with the law, judicial independence, impartial public administration
vdem_rule.note: Model-based estimates from several thousand country experts; V-Dem publishes no ranks, so the rank shown is computed here on the latest year.

wgi.name: World Bank Worldwide Governance Indicators
wgi.basis: Aggregate of dozens of perception surveys and expert assessments
wgi.note: The headline figure this file is set against.

unavailable.name: Freedom House Freedom in the World
unavailable.reason: Freedom House states its data are free for personal, academic and non-profit use and that commercial use needs prior formal permission; its current data file is also not at a stable open URL. Not stored here; the V-Dem indices cover the same ground.

unavailable.name: V-Dem country-year dataset (direct download)
unavailable.reason: The direct download is behind a form that asks for an email address and gender, which this build does not fill in. The same V-Dem v16 indices are taken from Our World in Data's republication instead, and are marked as republished.

unavailable.name: World Justice Project Rule of Law Index
unavailable.reason: The downloads page refused an automated request (HTTP 403), so no figures were read.

unavailable.name: Bertelsmann Transformation Index (BTI)
unavailable.reason: Downloadable, but it covers only developing and transition countries (no UAE and no high-income country), so it cannot serve as a cross-check for the UAE-centred comparison.
